description: Java class implementing a FreeMarker template transform for editing sub-content URLs within the OFBiz framework. It processes template arguments, retrieves sub-content data, and conditionally renders or wraps content for editing purposes.

classes.name: EditRenderSubContentTransform
classes.description: Implements a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel to facilitate editing sub-content URLs within OFBiz, handling content retrieval, wrapping, and rendering logic.

methods.name: getWrappedObject
methods.description: Deprecated method to get wrapped objects from the environment, wraps FreeMarkerWorker.getWrappedObject.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve arguments from the args map, wraps FreeMarkerWorker.getArg.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Main method that processes template arguments, retrieves sub-content data, and returns a Writer that either renders or wraps content based on 'editTemplate' flag.
